oracle: MSVC std::regex ECMAScript, default C locale
format: NREGEX01; little-endian u32 case count; each case u32-length pattern bytes/u8 compile success/u32 input count; each input u32-length bytes followed by search and full-match capture arrays. Capture count 0xffffffff means no match; each capture is i32 byte start and u32 byte length; -1 start is an unmatched group. Capture zero is whole match.
comparison: Compile result, search and full-match presence, complete capture vectors and raw byte offsets are exact.
portability: This corpus specifies the measured frozen MSVC C-locale profile. Cross-vendor ECMAScript grammar and locale equivalence is not claimed.
coverage: Alternation, groups, nested/lazy/empty repetition, capture resets, backreferences, positive/negative lookahead, character classes and named classes, anchors, word boundaries, arbitrary byte and NUL inputs, invalid syntax and word escaping. Runtime resource-limit errors are checked separately and propagate to C diagnostics.
